summary: testDiffModelParsesPendingGitWorkAndRefreshReplacesResult uses a real git repo with staged (staged.txt), unstaged (tracked.txt), and untracked (new.txt) changes and asserts branchLine, per-file status/additions/deletions for each, plus aggregate changedFileCount/additions/deletions summing across all three categories — genuinely fails if branch context, any per-path status, or any category is dropped from the aggregate.
